description: Fetch a transcript by id, waiting up to ~25s if it is still processing: status, metadata, and the plain text once complete. Set include_segments for timestamped segments, include_analysis for the AI analysis when one exists.

id.description: Transcript id from transcribe_url or list_transcripts.

include_analysis.description: Include the AI analysis and pace metrics. Default false.

wait_seconds.description: If still processing, wait up to this many seconds (0-55, default 25).

name: get_transcript
title: Get a transcript
